interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with high-visibility continental-style markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve sightlines by moving pedestrians past parked cars before they cross.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks, but lacks visible pedestrian-specific signals at the signalized crossing. The residential environment has wide lanes that may encourage higher vehicle speeds without physical traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals.

hazards.name: Wide crossing exposure
hazards.description: The lack of curb extensions or a median refuge increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic in the roadway.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide shade and create vertical friction that naturally encourages lower vehicle speeds.
